package.label.description: Label displayed in the archive header and xterm title

package.startup_script.description: Path to the script executed after extraction

package.compression_method.description: Compression method: gzip, bzip2, xz, zstd, lzo, lz4, pbzip2, pigz, base64, nocomp

package.compression_level.description: Compression level (1-9 or 1-22 depending on algorithm)

package.threads.description: Number of threads for parallel compressors

package.target_dir.description: Target directory for extraction (empty for temp dir)

package.noprogress.description: Do not show progress bar during decompression

package.nooverwrite.description: Do not overwrite if target directory already exists

package.current_dir.description: Use current directory as extraction base

package.enable_sha256.description: Generate SHA256 checksum for integrity validation

package.lsm_file.description: LSM file describing the package (empty if none)

package.license_file.description: License file to append to the archive (empty if none)

package.packaging_date.description: Packaging date override (empty for current date)

package.header_file.description: Header script file for custom startup behavior (empty if none)

package.cleanup_file.description: Cleanup script executed on interrupt or success (empty if none)

package.append_mode.description: Append files to an existing archive

package.nox11.description: Disable automatic xterm spawn in X11

package.nowait.description: Do not wait for user input after xterm execution

package.tar_extra_options.description: Extra options to pass to tar command

package.tar_format.description: Tar archive format (ustar, posix, v7, etc)

package.append_files.description: List of files to append if append_mode is true

archive.output_file.description: Output filename for the self-extracting archive
